{{Top|leg}}
'''Khrassh''' was an area of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Escabar]]. [[Merchant/Legends|Traders]] from Khrassh crossed the deserts to reach the world's newly opened [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. Along the way, they encountered [[Borcatu/Legends|borcatu]] who hitched a ride and started travelling off-planet.<ref name="COG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
